I'll lay out the test plan as a single JSON object with synthetic cases, expectations, tolerances, integrity checks, and the freeze procedure.

```json
{
  "plan": "rulemaking-notice extraction semantic contract, offline, synthetic",
  "conventions": {
    "no_field_names_imposed": "Expectations describe observable properties, not schema keys. Any representation passes if an evaluator can recover the property.",
    "source_fixture": "Each case supplies a short synthetic notice text with explicit character offsets. Every fixture is hashed before use; outputs must bind to that hash.",
    "verdicts": "ACCEPT if all listed accept observations hold and no reject observation holds. UNKNOWN is a valid value wherever the source is silent."
  },
  "test_cases": [
    {
      "id": "D1-received-date-only",
      "area": "date-only deadlines",
      "input": "\"Comments must be received on or before March 3, 2026.\" No clock or timezone anywhere in the notice.",
      "accept": [
        "Calendar date 2026-03-03 recovered as a date, not an instant.",
        "Clock and timezone each represented as unknown or absent.",
        "Submission semantics recorded as receipt, with its provenance span covering the phrase 'must be received on or before'.",
        "Deadline span offsets match the source text exactly."
      ],
      "reject": [
        "Any time of day, UTC conversion, or midnight instant appears without a source span.",
        "Semantics labeled postmark, filed, or sent.",
        "Date shifted by one day due to timezone assumption."
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D2-postmark-date-only",
      "area": "date-only deadlines",
      "input": "\"Written comments must be postmarked no later than April 15, 2026.\"",
      "accept": [
        "Date 2026-04-15 as date-only.",
        "Semantics recorded as postmark, span covers 'postmarked no later than'.",
        "Clock and timezone unknown."
      ],
      "reject": [
        "Semantics recorded as receipt.",
        "A delivery deadline invented as a second fact."
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D3-explicit-clock-preserved",
      "area": "date-only deadlines",
      "input": "\"Comments must be received by 5 p.m. Eastern Time on May 1, 2026.\"",
      "accept": [
        "Clock 17:00 and timezone label 'Eastern Time' preserved verbatim with spans.",
        "No conversion to a numeric offset unless the source states one.",
        "Receipt semantics with span."
      ],
      "reject": [
        "Timezone replaced by a fixed offset or IANA zone without source support.",
        "Clock dropped."
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D4-silent-semantics",
      "area": "date-only deadlines",
      "input": "\"The comment period closes June 10, 2026.\"",
      "accept": [
        "Date recovered.",
        "Receipt-vs-postmark marked unknown.",
        "Clock and timezone unknown."
      ],
      "reject": [
        "Receipt or postmark asserted as fact.",
        "A default such as end of business day asserted."
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "R1-amended-vs-historical",
      "area": "amended rule vs historical filing",
      "input": "\"This final rule amends the rule published at 85 FR 1234 on January 2, 2020. The 2020 rule took effect March 1, 2020. This rule is effective November 1, 2026.\"",
      "accept": [
        "Two distinct entities: the current amending action and the historical 2020 filing.",
        "A directed relationship from the current action to the historical filing meaning 'amends', with span covering 'amends the rule published at 85 FR 1234'.",
        "Effective date 2026-11-01 attached only to the current action; 2020-03-01 attached only to the historical filing.",
        "The citation '85 FR 1234' and date 2020-01-02 attached to the historical filing with spans."
      ],
      "reject": [
        "Entities merged into one rule.",
        "Any date attached to the wrong entity.",
        "Relationship direction reversed.",
        "Historical filing marked as the operative current rule."
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "R2-historical-only-no-amendment",
      "area": "amended rule vs historical filing",
      "input": "\"Background: the agency issued guidance on this topic at 80 FR 5678 (2015). This notice does not modify that guidance.\"",
      "accept": [
        "Historical filing recorded as a referenced entity.",
        "No 'amends' or 'supersedes' relationship emitted.",
        "If a relationship is emitted it is 'references' or equivalent, with span."
      ],
      "reject": [
        "An amendment relationship inferred.",
        "The 2015 date attached to the present notice."
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "R3-chain-acyclic",
      "area": "amended rule vs historical filing",
      "input": "Notice C amends rule B; text states B itself amended rule A.",
      "accept": [
        "Three entities, two directed edges C->B and B->A, each with its own span.",
        "Graph is acyclic and every edge endpoint resolves to an emitted entity."
      ],
      "reject": [
        "Edge A->C or any cycle.",
        "Edge to an identifier not present in output."
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "L1-two-facts-one-sentence",
      "area": "independently lossy assertions",
      "input": "\"Comments are due July 1, 2026, and electronic submissions should use the online portal.\"",
      "accept": [
        "The due date and the portal preference are each independently recoverable, each with its own span.",
        "Any unit count passes: one unit with two addressable parts, two units, or more.",
        "Dropping either fact is detectable because the other survives with its span."
      ],
      "reject": [
        "Either fact silently absent.",
        "Both facts share a single span that does not cover both phrases.",
        "A check that fails solely because the unit count is not a specific number."
      ],
      "note": "Evaluator must be written to tolerate decomposition variance; this case also tests the evaluator."
    },
    {
      "id": "L2-partial-loss-flagged",
      "area": "independently lossy assertions",
      "input": "Same as L1, but fixture is paired with a deliberately truncated output omitting the portal preference.",
      "accept": [
        "The truncated output is reported as incomplete for the portal fact only.",
        "The due date fact is still accepted on its own."
      ],
      "reject": [
        "Whole output rejected as a block with no per-fact attribution.",
        "Truncated output accepted as complete."
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "F1-hortatory-not-mandatory",
      "area": "uncertain directive force",
      "input": "\"Commenters are encouraged to include supporting data.\"",
      "accept": [
        "Force recorded as non-mandatory or hortatory, span covers 'are encouraged to'.",
        "No obligation entity created."
      ],
      "reject": [
        "Force recorded as must, shall, or required."
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "F2-ambiguous-force",
      "area": "uncertain directive force",
      "input": "\"Comments are to be submitted through the docket.\"",
      "accept": [
        "Force recorded as ambiguous or unknown, with the modal phrase span.",
        "Verbatim phrase preserved so a human can judge."
      ],
      "reject": [
        "Force resolved to must or should without a source modal supporting it."
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "F3-explicit-mandatory",
      "area": "uncertain directive force",
      "input": "\"Each comment must include the docket number.\"",
      "accept": [
        "Force recorded as mandatory with span on 'must'."
      ],
      "reject": [
        "Force downgraded to unknown when the source modal is explicit."
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "F4-structural-not-normative",
      "area": "uncertain directive force",
      "input": "Deadline sentence refers to 'the address in ADDRESSES above'; an address block exists elsewhere in the fixture.",
      "accept": [
        "A structural link from the deadline to the address block, labeled as reference or dependency.",
        "No requirement or obligation derived from the existence of the link."
      ],
      "reject": [
        "The dependency emitted as a legal must or should.",
        "The address block itself assigned directive force."
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "S1-status-from-markup-only",
      "area": "proposed/deleted/current",
      "input": "Fixture contains explicit supplied markers, e.g. text segments wrapped in insertion and deletion markers, plus one unmarked segment.",
      "accept": [
        "Marked segments receive proposed-insert or deleted status exactly matching the markers, with spans.",
        "Unmarked segment has status unknown or current-as-supplied, never inferred from surrounding prose."
      ],
      "reject": [
        "Status assigned to any segment lacking a marker.",
        "Marker boundaries altered."
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "S2-prose-without-markup",
      "area": "proposed/deleted/current",
      "input": "\"We propose to remove paragraph (b).\" No markup supplied.",
      "accept": [
        "The sentence is extracted as a statement of intent with span.",
        "No text segment is labeled deleted."
      ],
      "reject": [
        "Paragraph (b) or any segment marked deleted or proposed on the basis of prose alone."
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "P1-span-and-hash-binding",
      "area": "provenance",
      "input": "Any fixture; evaluator flips one byte outside all spans and re-runs binding check.",
      "accept": [
        "Every span's offsets slice the hashed source to the exact quoted text.",
        "Output carries the source hash; altered fixture produces a mismatch report."
      ],
      "reject": [
        "Span text reconstructed by normalization, whitespace collapse, or paraphrase.",
        "Hash absent or matching the altered source."
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "P2-ids-and-completion",
      "area": "identifiers and completion",
      "input": "Any fixture with at least three entities and one relationship.",
      "accept": [
        "All identifiers unique within the output.",
        "Every reference resolves to an emitted identifier.",
        "A completion marker is present and consistent: if it claims complete, no unit is marked pending; if any unit is pending, completion is not claimed."
      ],
      "reject": [
        "Duplicate identifier.",
        "Dangling reference.",
        "Completion claimed alongside pending units."
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "C1-coverage-is-bookkeeping",
      "area": "evidence coverage",
      "input": "Two outputs for one fixture: output X covers 95% of source chars but mislabels postmark as receipt; output Y covers 40% but every fact is correct.",
      "accept": [
        "Coverage reported for both as a number, separately from semantic verdicts.",
        "X fails D2-style semantic check despite high coverage.",
        "Y passes semantic checks; low coverage is reported, not treated as a semantic failure."
      ],
      "reject": [
        "Coverage used as a proxy for correctness in either direction."
      ]
    }
  ],
  "uncertainty_tolerances": {
    "dates": "Exact calendar match required. No tolerance for off-by-one.",
    "clock_timezone": "Unknown is correct when source is silent. When present, verbatim label required; numeric offsets only if the source states them.",
    "submission_semantics": "Three-valued: receipt, postmark, unknown. Unknown accepted only when source is silent.",
    "directive_force": "Three-valued: mandatory, non-mandatory, ambiguous. Ambiguous accepted when source modal is unclear; fabrication of either extreme fails.",
    "decomposition": "Any unit count accepted. Evaluator asserts recoverability per fact, never count.",
    "spans": "Exact offsets, zero tolerance. Multiple spans per fact allowed.",
    "relationships": "Label synonyms accepted if direction and endpoints are correct and a span supports the relation.",
    "status": "Unknown always accepted in absence of markup; any status in absence of markup fails."
  },
  "integrity_checks": [
    "Source hash present in output and equal to the fixture hash computed before extraction.",
    "Every span slices the fixture to the exact quoted text.",
    "Identifier set has no duplicates; all references resolve.",
    "Relationship and dependency graph is acyclic.",
    "Completion marker consistent with unit states.",
    "Structural dependency edges carry no force attribute.",
    "Status labels appear only on segments with supplied markup.",
    "Coverage metric emitted separately and never consulted by semantic verdict logic.",
    "No value in output lacks a span unless it is explicitly marked unknown or derived-by-evaluator."
  ],
  "reference_freeze_procedure": {
    "purpose": "Build a source-only reference per fixture before any extractor output is seen, so comparison cannot drift toward the output.",
    "steps": [
      "1. Hash each synthetic fixture. Record hash and fixture text in a sealed directory.",
      "2. Read only the fixture. For each atomic fact a careful reader can point to, record: the fact in plain words, one or more exact spans, and the uncertainty value (unknown, ambiguous) where the source is silent.",
      "3. Record relationships and structural links as directed pairs over reference facts, each with a span.",
      "4. Keep the reference compact: no schema, no unit count, no field names. Facts may map to many spans and spans to many facts.",
      "5. Label the reference as 'AI assessment, source-only, not gold'. Record author, date, and fixture hash in a header.",
      "6. Hash the reference file. Store the hash alongside the fixture hash. Do not edit afterward; corrections go in a new versioned reference with a new hash.",
      "7. Only after step 6 run the extractor and compare. Comparison asserts recoverability of each reference fact, never structural identity."
    ],
    "exposure_rule": "The reference must never be shown to the extractor, included in prompts, or revised after output inspection in the same version."
  },
  "execution_notes": {
    "runner": "Local only. Fixtures and references are plain text. No network, credentials, or external services.",
    "safety": "All fixtures are synthetic. No real docket numbers, agency text, or private data."
  }
}
```

The plan covers four semantic areas with paired positive and negative cases, plus provenance, identifier, and coverage checks. Each case states observable accept and reject conditions without fixing field names or unit counts. The freeze procedure seals a source-only, many-to-many, AI-assessment reference by hash before any extractor output is inspected.
